messages:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY deploy scheduled: inference-router config (change window 02:00-03:00 UTC). Canary plan: staggered ramp (5% -> 30% over 45m). Key changes: per-route rate caps, request timeouts, batching params. See snippet below.

alex: ack. canary duration and rollout looks fine, want to confirm we keep model routing pinned for canary?

morgan: +1 to pin. we should pin routing to model v2.1 for canary and fall back to v2.0 on errors. don't want cross-model traffic during rollout.

priya: added note: if p50 latency increases >200ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets we stop the ramp and revert to previous routing. Also suggest health check on kv-cache hit-rate.

jordan: ops note: dashboard is already prepared -> /dash/inference/rolling-configs. alerting: infra_warn on >5% 5xx, latency_alert on p95 > 1200ms. playbook updated in runbook (link).

laura: suggest a softer start for rate caps: keep global throttle at 80% of target for first 10m then move to target. reduces spike risk.

alex: agreed. also lowering batch_window_ms from 20 -> 12 to reduce tail latency might reduce throughput; ensure autoscale headroom.

morgan: autoscaler policy checked: buffer=20% GPU headroom, scale-cooldown 3m. should be fine for staging -> canary.

priya: config snippet I'm going to deploy (yaml):
```yaml
service: inference-router
canary:
  initial_percent: 5
  ramp_minutes: 45
routing:
  model_pin: v2.1
  fallback_model: v2.0
limits:
  per_route_rps: 35
  global_burst: 200
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 8000
batching:
  max_tokens: 768
  window_ms: 12
  max_batch_size: 48
health_checks:
  kv_cache_hit_rate_threshold: 0.6
  p50_latency_fail_threshold_ms: 200
```

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy (config-only) at 02:05 UTC. target 5% traffic to pinned routing v2.1.

alex: watching logs. hooking up a quick smoke run for the internal test suite.

morgan: saw slight bump in p95 at t+6m (from 820ms -> 980ms) but p50 stable. no errors.

priya: kv-cache hit-rate at t+10m = 0.62, within threshold. p50 still +90ms, within expected.

laura: increasing canary to 15% now per ramp schedule. doing the soft-start for rate caps as discussed.

deploy-bot: Canary updated -> 15% at 02:20 UTC.

jordan: alerting clear so far. one 502 spike at t+22m from a single route, auto-retry handled, rate-limited user, no cascading.

alex: decision point: do we continue to 30% or pin at 15% and run extended soak? my vote: proceed to 30% but keep fast rollback gates.

priya: agree to continue to 30% conditional on no >1% error increase over baseline and latency SLOs hold.

morgan: rolling to 30% now. bumping canary -> 30% at 02:35 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary updated -> 30%.

priya: monitoring: p95 spiked briefly to 1300ms at t+8s after ramp but settled to 940ms. error rate unchanged.

laura: per-route throttles showing expected enforcement, global requests within budget.

jordan: ops confirms no escalation. leaving model_pin in place until full ramp completes.

alex: final check: we'll keep the model pin for the entire change window, and we have rollback playbook ready (rollback config and unpin routing).

morgan: noted. schedule post-mortem if any regressions detected.

deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY deploy finished: canary reached 30% and remained stable through change window. No rollback executed. release notes tag: release/config-1865432100.

priya: thanks all. will follow up with detailed telemetry and a short summary in the release notes doc. :thumbsup:

laura: great run. leaving this thread open for one hour for any late observations.

alex: closing out from my side. good job team.
